'''Jule''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Militia Officer who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During a mission on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Jule was a lone survivor of an ill-fated squad that were ambushed. He tasked a Republic spacer to finish his mission by slicing the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] comm relays.
